name: Summon Vanth
levelText: arcanist 6, cleric 6, oracle 6, sorcerer 6, summoner 5, summoner (unchained) 5, warpriest 6, witch 6, wizard 6
componentsText: V, S, F/DF (a vulture skull funerary mask)
